title: Seattle Pacific University (SPU)
summary: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) is a university in Seattle. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with SPU.

sections.heading: What SPU is known for
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) is a private nonprofit institution with an undergraduate enrollment of 1,762 students. The university has an admission rate of approximately 83.4%, reflecting its selective admission process. SPU is particularly known for its strong programs in health and business fields, with about 20.11% of students enrolled in health-related programs and 13.58% pursuing business studies. These areas represent significant portions of the university's academic offerings, highlighting its focus on preparing students for careers in these sectors.

sections.heading: Key strengths
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) is a private nonprofit institution recognized for its diverse academic programs. A notable strength of SPU is its health-related programs, which account for approximately 20.11% of student enrollment, reflecting a significant emphasis on preparing students for careers in health fields. Additionally, education programs represent about 3.88% of the academic offerings, contributing to the university's commitment to training future educators. These program distributions illustrate SPU's focus on areas that support community well-being and development.

sections.heading: Popular majors
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) offers a variety of popular majors, with health-related programs being the most prominent, comprising about 20.11% of student enrollment. Business programs follow, representing approximately 13.58% of the academic population. Computer-related fields account for around 6.53%, while education programs make up about 3.88%. Public administration programs are not represented among the popular majors at SPU. This distribution highlights the university's emphasis on health, business, and technology disciplines.

SPU evaluates candidates based on various academic and personal criteria to ensure a good fit with the university's educational environment.

sections.heading: How to read SPU tuition
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) charges a tuition fee of $40,407 for both in-state and out-of-state students. This uniform tuition rate applies regardless of residency status. The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as housing, meals, books, and personal costs, amounts to $56,826. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and families plan for the overall financial commitment required to attend SPU.

sections.heading: Financial aid
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) offers financial aid to assist students in managing the cost of attendance. Approximately 35.34% of students receive Pell Grants, which are federal subsidies for undergraduate education. Among students who complete their programs, the median debt incurred is $24,000. Prospective students can explore detailed financial aid information and use the net price calculator on SPU's official website. Additional data about costs and aid is also available through the U.S. Department of Education's College Scorecard.

sections.heading: Colleges and schools
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) does not currently organize its academic offerings into distinct colleges or schools. Instead, the university provides a range of programs and courses designed to meet diverse educational interests and career goals. SPU emphasizes a comprehensive liberal arts education combined with professional preparation, allowing students to engage in interdisciplinary studies across various fields. This approach supports a flexible and integrated learning experience tailored to individual student needs.

sections.heading: Academic features
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) offers academic programs characterized by a student-faculty ratio of 13, facilitating personalized instruction and close interaction between students and professors. The university emphasizes a comprehensive liberal arts education alongside professional preparation, promoting interdisciplinary learning and flexibility in course selection. This structure supports students in tailoring their academic experience to align with their individual interests and career objectives.

sections.heading: Degree levels
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) offers degree programs at multiple levels, including undergraduate and graduate studies. The university provides bachelor's degrees across a variety of disciplines, with particular strengths in health, business, and education fields. Graduate degree options are also available, allowing students to pursue advanced studies and professional development. SPU's academic structure supports a comprehensive liberal arts education combined with specialized professional preparation, enabling students to tailor their educational paths according to their career goals.

sections.heading: Housing and dining
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) offers housing options with a consistent cost for students living on or off campus. The room and board expenses are set at $16,491 regardless of whether students choose to reside in university housing or off-campus accommodations. This pricing structure provides students with a clear understanding of their housing and dining costs as part of their overall educational expenses at SPU.

sections.heading: Career outcomes
paragraphs: Career outcomes for students at Seattle Pacific University (SPU) indicate that approximately 61.95% of students complete their programs within 150% of the expected time. Among those who complete their degrees, the median debt incurred is about $24,000. Earnings data show that median annual income for graduates six years after entry is $51,496, increasing to $64,506 ten years after entry. These figures reflect the financial trajectory of SPU graduates as they advance in their careers.

sections.heading: Internships and research
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) provides opportunities for students to engage in internships and research as part of their academic experience. These practical experiences allow students to apply theoretical knowledge in real-world settings, enhancing their professional skills and career readiness. SPU encourages involvement in research projects across various disciplines, supporting student development through hands-on learning and faculty mentorship. For more detailed information about available programs and opportunities, prospective students and interested parties can visit the university's official catalog at https://spu.edu/.

sections.heading: Diversity
paragraphs: Seattle Pacific University (SPU) demonstrates a diverse student body with a gender distribution of approximately 35.07% men and 64.93% women. The racial and ethnic composition includes about 30.7% White students, 8.8% Black students, 19.18% Hispanic students, and 14.3% Asian students. Additionally, around 35.34% of the student population receives Pell Grants, indicating a significant portion of students with financial need. This diversity reflects SPU's commitment to fostering an inclusive educational environment.

Prospective students interested in this field may find SPU's program suitable depending on their academic and career goals.
